desc: The Firefighter Tribute Edition commemorates not only the actual firefighter, but also the public trust that Americans place in all firefighters who answer a call of distress. The original art for this rifle has been cut by hand engraver Rob Bunting and through a mechanical transfer the scenes and tribute text is impressed directly onto the nickel plated receiver cover retaining all of the hand engraved elements of the original. The Firefighter Tribute Edition is outfitted with a 20 octagonal barrel topped with classic buckhorn sights like all rifles in the award-winning Golden Boy family.
